title: Hearty Uruguayan Pumpkin Empanadas
description: These empanadas are a traditional Uruguayan dish featuring pumpkin and score fat, made with a yeasty dough and a glassy jelly filling, perfect for a macrobiotic friendly brunch, the pumpkin and score fat give it a hearty flavor
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the yeast, flour, salt, sugar, and water to make the dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
In a separate bowl, mix together the mashed pumpkin, score fat, and beaten egg.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch and cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the pumpkin mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half circle and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with oil and bake for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the empanadas are baking, heat the jelly in a small saucepan over low heat until it is warm and syrupy.
Serve the empanadas warm with the warm jelly spooned over the top.
